asr_text: How does an 11 labs voice agent actually listen and answer four parts? One, a fine -tuned speech -to -text model to hear the caller. Two, any language model you choose or a custom LLM. Three, low -latency text -to -speech with over 5 ,000 voices. Four, a turn -taking model which handles conversation timing. Slow replies, higher -quality voices models and LLMs can increase response time. Save this and watch the full lesson in episode 14.
